thought.text: Let me wait for the Angular dev server to build and become ready.

reasoning_content: Let's wait for the frontend to build and start up. I'll try polling for readiness.

action.command:
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  if grep -qi "Application bundle\|watch mode\|Local:\|Compiled in\|successfully\| - Local:" /tmp/frontend.log 2>/dev/null; then
    if curl -s --max-time 3 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:4200 2>/dev/null | grep -q 200; then
      echo "FRONTEND READY after ~$((i*8))s"; break
    fi
  fi
  sleep 8
done
echo "=== frontend log tail ==="
tail -25 /tmp/frontend.log
